about.title: About ShifaLink
about.description: ShifaLink is a responsive, privacy-conscious digital healthcare platform connecting patients, qualified physicians, and certified diagnostic centers across unified clinical workflows.
about.pillar1Desc: Medical records in ShifaLink Drive are private by default. Access is granted only with explicit, time-bounded, revocable patient consent.
about.pillar2Desc: Every doctor and diagnostic organization is verified through formal credentialing review before appearing in public directories.
about.pillar3Desc: AI assistants are restricted to strict role-based tool boundaries without direct database access, following evidence-based clinical protocols.
